SetArrayElement.changesGlobals: Element `index` of the array the caller's parameter ArrayName names is overwritten in place; when that parameter is a name standing for a global array (Struct::get_hunt resolves names), the GLOBAL array's element changes (name = the value of the caller's parameter named by the ArrayName argument).
SetArrayElement.uncertain: The new value's kind is not checked against the array's element type: for string / localstring / pair / vector / struct / array arrays the cell takes NewValue's raw value whatever its kind (a name NewValue is first resolved through globals), so the array's elements may hold a value of another kind than the array says. Integer / name arrays store the raw word; float arrays convert integers. The checker should treat the array (the caller's member named by ArrayName, or the global) as possibly holding any element kind after this call.
SetArrayElement.notes: No new members in the caller's parameters; an existing array member is mutated in place.

SetEventHandler.uncertain: When the event arrives the handler's parameters are params= merged with the EVENT's own data (payload, whatever the sender attached - not listable here): over-approximate the handler's parameters with unknown members.
SetEventHandler.notes: Later, asynchronously: a normal handler runs as an INTERRUPT on the calling script (preempt; or as a new spawned script when its object has the spawn-handlers flag); its `return` values are merged into the parameters of the level it interrupted. With Exception, the script's OnExceptionRun script runs first (interrupt, given an unnamed name), then the handler REPLACES the calling script (bind_script: its parameters reset - like Goto).

SetException.uncertain: Handler parameters = params= merged with the event's payload (unknown members).

SetExceptionHandler.uncertain: Handler parameters = params= merged with the event's payload (unknown members).
SetExceptionHandler.notes: Always an exception handler: when the event arrives, OnExceptionRun's script runs as an interrupt, then the handler replaces the calling script (its parameters reset to the handler's defaults + params + event data).
